card.lights_out: Every 8 hours the pit goes dark for 1 hour. Outside a saferoom, the Ceiling Tick roll on the floor overview applies.
card.day_ends: At a saferoom Long Rest, or at 24 in-game hours.
card.collapse: Day 5, at 24 in-game hours, the floor collapses. A missed collapse is death.
